prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object, move to destination, inspect object, perform specific task, scan area if necessary.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = FindAndGrabObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = InspectObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
		DO FindAndGrabObject
		DO MoveToDestination
		DO InspectObject
		DO SpecificTask
	END
